reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; not provably public domain: Johann Gottfried Schicht: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source; the score has bars of another length (bar 6, 7), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001284 (the melody read from 001284a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001284a.nwc).
